name: furniture-backend
description: Medusa backend for furniture ecommerce + bespoke

scripts.dev: node scripts/ensure-admin-dev-stable.mjs && MEDUSA_RUNTIME_COMMAND=develop node scripts/ensure-admin-runtime-ready.mjs && MEDUSA_RUNTIME_COMMAND=develop medusa develop --types
scripts.dev:reset: bash scripts/clean-admin-vite.sh && node scripts/ensure-admin-dev-stable.mjs && MEDUSA_RUNTIME_COMMAND=develop node scripts/ensure-admin-runtime-ready.mjs && MEDUSA_RUNTIME_COMMAND=develop medusa develop --types
scripts.postinstall: node scripts/patch-skip-cart-promotions.mjs && node scripts/patch-medusa-develop-watch.mjs --warn-only && node scripts/finalize-admin-vite-cache.mjs
